summary: Delek Logistics Partners, LP (issuer) filed an 8-K reporting the pricing of $800 million aggregate principal amount of 6.875% senior notes due 2034, issued at par, alongside a conditional partial redemption of $400 million of its outstanding 8.625% senior notes due 2029 at 104.313% of principal plus accrued interest. The redemption is conditioned on closing the new notes offering, expected May 14, 2026. Proceeds will also repurchase all outstanding 7.125% senior notes due 2028. This is a routine refinancing and debt management transaction; no board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for customary closing conditions and interest rate environment.
